verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships a built-in AI component, Semgrep Assistant, that post-processes findings to cut noise by about 20%. Marketing and docs also describe AI reasoning for detection, triage and remediation, and AI-powered detection of business-logic flaws. This is narrow, automated triage and detection help rather than an assistant users can hand open-ended tasks to, and its evidence is thin. Missing for 10: first-party docs for Semgrep Assistant itself, evidence of user-initiated task delegation (e.g. asking the assistant to fix or triage on request), detail on remediation/autofix by the assistant, and independent hands-on corroboration.
